notes.title: Preview: Next Version of Askutron and Movie Quiz DLC
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/145590cfcc148147bbcf1c157c4e430633c182cf.jpg[/img]

While news have been slow, the work on the next version of Askutron Quiz Show is still very much in progress. The goal is to leave Early Access before the end of 2019. A new version will be ready for testing soon and new features will be rolled out on a continuous basis.

[b]What to Expect[/b]

One of our goals for the new version of Askutron was to improve the graphics, finally giving the game the appropriate TV studio set it deserves. But we also made changes to the core gameplay and eliminated many bugs based on the feedback of our valued Early Access players.

Here is a list with just some of the most important changes you can expect in the new version. Many of which will already be included in the upcoming test version, while others will only arrive later next year.

[list]
[*] completely new 3D TV studio set
[*] improved overall graphics and user interface
[*] better question selection algorithm
[*] revamped core game mechanics, especially in "Cake Conflict" and "Finale" modes
[*] more powerful game options including the possibility to mix and match different quizzes in one quiz round
[*] 2 players can play on one keyboard
[*] join the game with your mobile devices even without downloading the app, just scan the QR code and the Buzzer will open in your browser
[*] players can leave and join the game at any point in time, even during the game
[*] further improved Buzz! buzzer support (showing the appropriate colors in the user interface)
[*] a new browser-based quiz editor that allows players to collaborate and share more easily
[*] and more...
[/list]

[b]Free Movie Quiz DLC[/b]

Also upcoming is a free movie quiz DLC that offers thousands of questions for movies of all genres and eras, including new and different rounds and question types. This DLC will also support various languages on top of English and German!

[b]Timeframe and Development[/b]

We are planning on releasing the next version of the game that includes many of the features mentioned above within Q1 2019. With some new features (especially the new quiz editor) following later in the year.

If you want to be on the bleeding edge or already would like to take advantage of some of the improvements (like browser-support for buzzers), we are planning on releasing a preview on a beta test channel before New Year's eve this year! The announcement will contain details about this version.

notes.title: Askutron v0.5.2 - Bugfixes, and Work in Progress
notes.notes:
Good morning everyone!

While updates have been scarce over the last months we are still working on the game. In fact there are a lot of improvements coming to graphics and gameplay. Our goal was to have all of that done by Christmas this year. We're trying hard to make it happen in time.

In the meantime we just released a small but important bugfix release that was long overdue. Sorry to all the players who experienced problems!

[h1]Askutron v0.5.2 - Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed: Finale was skipped for some players after the first game played in a session
[*] Fixed: Some players saw repeating questions because the "already seen questions" weren't properly saved
[*] Fixed: In certain configurations the mode "Viewpoints" always lead to the finale, even if more play time had been configured
[*] Fixed: "It Is Known" achievement didn't unlock by playing "A Quiz of Ice and Fire" from the Workshop
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming update and survey about new content languages
notes.notes:
While it has been a bit quiet on our end in the last few weeks we can assure you work on Askutron Quiz Show continues.

The next update is planned for Saturday, March 31st 2018. It will include bugfixes, more questions and the new "ghost mode", that allows playing against other players online even when they are not online at the same time. More details about this new mode will be found in the release notes.

Additionally we are planning on adding new official question packs for languages other than English and German. If you use Twitter, please feel free to give your vote in our small survey:
[url]https://twitter.com/askutron/status/979039582351224832[/url]

Currently we're thinking about Russian, Chinese, Arabic or Spanish. Please let us know what you think!

notes.title: Happy new year - Patch Notes Jan 3, 2018
notes.notes:
Happy new year everyone!

We hope you had a relaxing christmas and a good start into 2018.
In our first update this year we fixed a couple of bugs.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[b]Mobile controller connection issues[/b]

Mobile controllers had trouble connecting to the Askutron relay which is why they only worked when in the same wifi network as the computer  hosting the game. This is fixed now, so you don't have to be in the same wifi. For instance it's enough for you phone to have internet access via 3G.

[b]Exclamation mark![/b]

We had a bug in the host's voice where it would read out punctuation in sentences such as: "Wrong again <Player Name>!"
Here it would read "Wrong again Markus, exclamation mark". This does not happen anymore.

[b]Repeat questions[/b]

Some players were rightfully complaining about repeat questions. This should not happen seeing as we have several thousand questions.
The reason it [i]did[/i] happen was our question selection algorithm.
It's supposed to favour questions that have been upvoted so that players will get better questions.

Unfortunately we overdid it a bit which is why people were seeing repeat questions. The algorithm always picked the questions in more or less the same order from only the highest rated ones. We now fixed this so that this shouldn't happen anymore.

[h1]Upcoming[/h1]

We're still working on our new "ghost" mode. More about that later this month.
Also we are still adding more opinion questions to have a wider variety of them.

notes.title: Stats & Ranks, Popular Quizzes, Reworked Finale, Stars, New Characters... - Patch Notes Nov 24, 2017
notes.notes:
This week we have quite a few exciting improvements to the game! 

[h1]Statistics and Ranks[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/75f923bfa301d98af958eae651e6ecc65a38fc95.jpg[/img]

With this patch we're introducing basic player statistics along with global ranking! Stats and ranks are only recorded for plays starting with this version, so it will take some time for all players to be ranked. 

The stats for your main profile (which is named liked your Steam user account) are now displayed right in the main menu. Ranks are updated after every game.

[h1]Popular Player Quizzes[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/c6761f5b004a97fa799fa22346a1a5dec70bc36e.jpg[/img]

To make it easier for you to discover Workshop quizzes created by other players we added a small list of currently popular player quizzes to the main menu (see screenshot above). 

Clicking on the title will open the Quiz's workshop page if you want to see details. The stars (between 1 and 5) show ratings by other players. To make it even easier, we added a download button that immediately subscribes, downloads and installs the quiz so you can start playing it right away! (Quizzes downloaded via the Workshop website can only be played after restarting the game)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/b303a913a472bae363439cd651e780050d40e690.jpg[/img]

We hope that this way more players will discover the awesome player-generated quizzes already on the Workshop, such as:

[list]
 [*] Star Trek Voyager [i]by clemenskaa[/i]
 [*] All About Harry Potter [i]by kidrocket[/i]
 [*] Inconceivable! The Princess Bride [i]by kidrocket[/i]
 [*] A Quiz of Ice and Fire [i]by blackpirateroberts[/i]
 [*] Video Games [i]by blackpirateroberts[/i]
 [*] and "alles mögliche" [i]by Larumpa[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Automatic Workshop Upload[/h1]

Up until now you had to manually trigger the upload of your quizzes to the Steam Workshop by pressing F6 in the menu. But from now on quizzes that have the "share on Steam Workshop" checkbox in the quiz editor checked will automatically uploaded when the game launches.

[h1]Reworked Finale and Introduction of Stars[/h1]

The finale now works differently. Player scores are converted into [i]stars[/i] at the beginning of the finale, with the best player getting 10 stars and all other players getting a number of stars based on many points they had before in relation to the best player. Correct answers add one star, wrong ones subtract one. Bonus awards also add one star. At the end the player with the most stars wins. 

The number of stars you won are persistently tracked in your profile and stats.

[h1]Unlockable Characters and Buzzers Coming Soon[/h1]

The introduction of [i]stars[/i] paves the way for our planned content update which will deliver new unlockable characters and buzzer sounds! We'll reveal more about the update in the coming weeks.

What we can already say is that you'll need stars to unlock new characters and buzzers. You can start saving up on stars right now!

[h1]Skipping Score Sequence[/h1]

To speed up the game we added the possibility to skip the high score table sequence.

notes.title: Online Mode Fixes, Question Selection, Master Volume - Patch Notes Nov 17, 2017
notes.notes:
This patch contains a few bugfixes and improvements. Here are the most important bits:

[h1]Online Mode Fixes[/h1]

Until now the online mode had some serious bugs, which mostly have been fixed now! From a technical point of view the online should just work now!

We're still working on how to better present and perform the match making. Currently you can select all the same settings as in single-player mode including the quiz to play, and once you're matched with someone the host's settings will be applied. Ideally in the future you will be only matched with players that have the same / similar settings. Though as the number of players right now is quite low, we figured this way would be better fow now.

Of course you can also still simply open your online game with a private lobby and simply invite friends to join via Steam.

There is one outstanding issue with the online mode which is image question. Players that do not already have the image for a question (because it's not a standard question and the client hasn't subscribed/downloaded the selected themed quiz) will not see the image in question. This obviously needs to be fixed now by either requiring all matched players to have subscribed to the selected quiz or transfering the image on-demand.

[h1]Improved Question Selection[/h1]

The randomization in the question selection algorithm has been improved to produce more random results from game to game. 

The tracking of which players have seen which questions already was also fixed to minimize question repitition (which is already quite low due to the number of questions). When selecting questions the game first computes for each question how often it has been played for each player in the lobby. Subsequently questions are sorted by the number of occurances first so that a question moves to the very end of the selection list once it has been played.

[h1]Master Volume Setting[/h1]

We added a master volume setting to the options.

notes.title: Mid October Update: Completed Steam Workshop Integration, Achievements, Cloud Sync, and more
notes.notes:
You may have noticed a rather sizeable update coming to your Steam library for Askutron recently. Here's what we changed!

[h1]Completed Steam Workshop Integration[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/2eb2e31ebad9055b42146a5b418a8ba1e20742f5.jpg[/img]

You can now create, share, download and play downloaded quizzes via Steam Workshop! 

To upload your own quiz, first create it using the included quiz editor, check the "allow sharing on Workshop" and save it. Then start the game and in the main menu press F6 to upload your quiz to the Workshop.

To download new quizzes created by other users open the Workshop page in your browser or in-game on the Themed Quiz screen by pressing X. Simply subscribe to the quizzes and they will be downloaded when you start the game the next time. 

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

We added 26 achievements including four hidden ones to the game! Can you unlock them all?

[h1]Cloud Sync[/h1]

Cloud Synchronization now works across all platforms (Windows, Mac and Linux) to synchronize your custom quizzes, user profiles and statistics.

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]

We improved performance of the game a little so that it runs more smoothly on laptops without dedicated graphics cards, such as my Dell XPS 13. We also added a simple graphics setting that you can use to squeeze out more performance by disabling effects such as Ambient Occlusion or Anti Aliasing.

[h1]Media Bundle[/h1]

Until today the game always downloaded all audio and other media files on-demand as we were still changing things. Now we added a media bundle for German and English that is included with the Steam distribution including all media files, so that you can now play the game and have the host reading questions even when you are offline!

Note that this does not included audio for user generated quizzes from the Steam Workshop. You will still need internet access in order to have those questions read out aloud.

[h1]Online Mode[/h1]

The online mode is still a bit buggy at times when played with more than two computers via network. We're still working on this!

[h1]Various Smaller Improvements and Bugfixes[/h1]

On top of all of this several smaller improvements and bugfixes can be found here and there. 

[h1]Soon To Be Released[/h1]

We're relentlessly working on getting the first version ready for Early Access! Please feel free to subscribe to our newsletter over at https://askutron.com to be notified when the game is released!

notes.title: Update: Added Quiz Editor, Mode Selection, Steam Workshop, Steam Cloud and various improvements
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the latest update to Askutron - the Quiz show game - brought a whole bunch of improvements!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/13a8f2aa21621b3278faaeede01a8097b3bc9ff2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quiz Editor[/h1]

You can now use the quiz editor to create your own quizzes! Add as many questions as you like. You can even add images to the questions. By default your own quizzes will only be visible to you on your PC. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/a8115d96371f80b8028fa7986d83d9d79b1aad81.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Workshop[/h1]

We're working on the Steam Workshop integration and are halfway there. If you enable Steamworks sharing for your quiz in the editor, you can press F6 in the main menu of the game to upload your quiz to the Steam Workshop where other players will be able to see and subscribe to your quiz! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/4b4229817317caf53ee6dc5d61f5f8f9a106334c.jpg[/img]

Well, that's the first half of the integration. The second half is the part where you can actually play the quizzes created by other players. This will be released with the next update, so stay tuned! Maybe you can use the waiting time to prepare your very first quiz for the Workshop!

[h1]Mode Selection[/h1]

We just added a rudimentary mode selection. Where before the sequence of game modes was fixed you can now choose which of the modes you actually want to play.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/39f85a76b5ffd785b2fe9e7390489ae403dd60d4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Cloud[/h1]

User profiles, statistics and quizzes you created are now automatically backed up using the Steam Cloud!

[h1]Category Selection[/h1]

The new and improved category selection now chooses the 4 random options more intelligently, avoiding duplicates and selecting categories based on how many questions they contain relative to the total number of questions in the quiz.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/866765cc486c0c78f9c3bbcfccdf07a5bd86266e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Various Improvements[/h1]

On top of all this we had several smaller improvements throughout the game.

[list]
 [*] Question difficulty is now managed by the game (UI for selecting the difficulty is still in progress)
 [*] 2,500 new English questions added!
 [*] Answers selected on the app are now highlighted more strongly by not only increasing the size of the selected answer, but also decreasing the size of the other options
 [*] The "Ready" screen of the mobile app now also displays the QR code that other people can use to join the game
[/list]

[h1]What's next[/h1]

We're still working hard on getting the game ready for Early Access. Our next step is publishing the "Coming Soon" page of the game on Steam for which we still need a trailer. Working on that, too...

In the meantime we appreciate the help of our alpha testers to get rid of the remaining bugs!

We just added a rudimentary mode selection. Where before the sequence of game modes was fixed you can now choose which of the modes you actually want to play.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/39f85a76b5ffd785b2fe9e7390489ae403dd60d4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Cloud[/h1]

User profiles, statistics and quizzes you created are now automatically backed up using the Steam Cloud!

[h1]Category Selection[/h1]

The new and improved category selection now chooses the 4 random options more intelligently, avoiding duplicates and selecting categories based on how many questions they contain relative to the total number of questions in the quiz.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30740462/866765cc486c0c78f9c3bbcfccdf07a5bd86266e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Various Improvements[/h1]

On top of all this we had several smaller improvements throughout the game.

[list]
 [*] Question difficulty is now managed by the game (UI for selecting the difficulty is still in progress)
 [*] 2,500 new English questions added!
 [*] Answers selected on the app are now highlighted more strongly by not only increasing the size of the selected answer, but also decreasing the size of the other options
 [*] The "Ready" screen of the mobile app now also displays the QR code that other people can use to join the game
[/list]

[h1]What's next[/h1]

We're still working hard on getting the game ready for Early Access. Our next step is publishing the "Coming Soon" page of the game on Steam for which we still need a trailer. Working on that, too...

In the meantime we appreciate the help of our alpha testers to get rid of the remaining bugs!
